content.short: Stablecoin payments infrastructure for PSPs, neobanks and remittance companies.
content.description: Levl, based in Zug with a Canadian entity in Toronto, gives payment companies instant, round-the-clock settlement in fiat or stablecoins. Its suite includes stablecoin liquidity, USD named accounts that show the client's name on each transaction, on and off-ramps and remittances. It is a member of a FINMA-recognised self-regulatory body and works with partners such as LemFi and TerraPay.
content.meta: Levl gives PSPs, neobanks and remitters instant stablecoin and fiat settlement, named USD accounts and ramps.
